answer: Sybil resistance via a shared insurance pool: each registration posts a bond into a common dune of collateral, and confirmed collusion is paid out of the offenders' stake to the agents they harmed. The pool's size is a public beacon of how costly an attack must be — an attacker funds everyone else's defense. A lone honest join echoes a tiny deposit back on good standing, but a mass of sybils forfeits a pool far larger than any gain.
